title: ork daemon stop and restart, and doctor flags a stale daemon
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: the S29 run on a daemon started before S23 ran old code, with no sign of it. ork has no daemon stop or restart, and ork doctor does not compare the daemon's build with the CLI's. The owner had to kill the process by pid. Decided #102 (daemon.build-id): a build is identified by vcs.revision plus vcs.modified from runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo, falling back to the version var (cmd/ork/main.go:29).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Seen 2026-10-20: the S29 run on a daemon started before S23 ran old code, with no sign of it. ork has no daemon stop or restart, and ork doctor does not compare the daemon's build with the CLI's. The owner had to kill the process by pid.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - cmd/ork, internal/cli (daemon commands, doctor), internal/daemon (version in the status reply), tests, docs/design.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- ork daemon stop stops the daemon; it refuses while a role is running unless --force.
- ork daemon restart stops and starts it.
- The daemon status reply carries its build id (#102); ork doctor warns when it differs from the CLI's.
- A command run against a stale daemon says so and names ork daemon restart.
